Class PdfFileManager

java.lang.Object
com.shaft.tools.io.PdfFileManager
public class PdfFileManager extends Object
Reads PDF text and processes native, scanned, and mixed multipage PDF documents.

The legacy text-reading methods remain source compatible. Document processing uses native positioned text first and the optional shaft-ocr provider when pixels contain text that the PDF text layer does not cover.
